name: Toto Calzados
description: Uruguayan footwear retailer with branches across the country. Sells sandals, sneakers, shoes, boots and accessories for women, men and children, including Skechers and its own Korium line. Delivers to the whole country and offers branch pickup.
description_es: Cadena uruguaya de calzado con sucursales en el país. Vende sandalias, championes, zapatos, botas y accesorios para mujer, hombre y niños, incluyendo Skechers y su línea propia Korium. Entrega en todo el país y ofrece retiro en sucursal.

ships_to.notes: Home delivery by courier to the whole country (Montevideo up to 72 hours, interior up to 7 business days) per the store's FAQ; options are shown at checkout.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Branch pickup available except at outlet branches; up to 7 business days.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

shopping_notes: Storefront is a JavaScript-rendered VTEX site; the FAQ and branch pages exist as routes. robots.txt disallows /busca/ (internal search), checkout and account paths.

sources.supports: Home page: nationwide delivery banner, categories and brands
FAQ: courier home delivery, branch pickup except outlets, delivery times by zone
Disallowed paths: search, checkout and account
